title: cvENGINE Sentinel result contract
description: Both halves of the exchange between cvENGINE and a Sentinel. $defs/targets is what the server hands a Sentinel for each task kind (the task's target); $defs/results is what a Sentinel sends to POST /api/v1/sentinel/tasks/{id}/result. The server clips and validates every result anyway (agentapi.sentinel_broker.clean_result); this file is what a correct client keeps to, so the server never has to. Bounds are asserted equal to the server's own limits, and every target the server builds is validated against it, by tests/test_sentinel_contract.py. Bump contract_version (and say so in CHANGELOG) for any change a client must follow.

cve_ids.description: Optional: the CVE ids the template names (nuclei's classification.cve-id). Only well-formed ids are kept; a result without the field is stored without it.

type.description: Optional (1.3.5): nuclei's protocol type of the template (its "type" field). The server keeps it, lowercased, when it is one of http, tcp, network, javascript, dns, ssl, headless, file, whois, code or websocket, and drops any other value.

request.description: Optional (1.3.5): the request the template sent when it matched. The server keeps the first 4096 characters, control bytes but not newlines removed.

response.description: Optional (1.3.5): the answer that matched. The server keeps the first 4096 characters, control bytes but not newlines removed.

report.description: the raw WPScan JSON report; at most 8 MiB serialised

manufacturer.description: informational: cvENGINE stores the product, as a local wafw00f run does, not who makes it

generic.description: something blocked the probes but wafw00f could name no product

xml.description: the raw nmap -oX report; cvENGINE reads it with the same hardened parser as a local run
the raw nmap -oX report; cvENGINE reads it with the same hardened parser as a local run

vulnerable.description: null: the detector could not decide (inconclusive)

painted.description: false: the server painted nothing before the wait ran out

image.description: the pre-authentication screen as a PNG of at most 4 MiB; the reading of it stays on the server

open.description: true: the one credential-less attempt was let through; null: this Sentinel has no client for the database

plain.description: the plain SYN drew a reset

odd.description: the FIN+PSH+URG segment drew a reset; null when it was not sent

valid.description: mode validate: nuclei -validate accepted the template

fixture_ok.description: mode validate: the template did not match a benign loopback fixture; null when not run

outcomes.description: mode test: one per target, in order

hit.description: the first nuclei result line of the host, its request and response cut to 8000 characters

etags.description: tags the run must always exclude (dos)
tags the run must always exclude (dos)
tags the run must always exclude (dos)

token.description: the project's WPScan API token, for this one run; the server replaces it with *** once the task ends

nmap_full.description: one address: every TCP port, open ports only

nmap_verify.description: nmap service detection (and safe NSE scripts) on named ports of one address

scripts.description: NSE scripts by name; a Sentinel runs only the names on its own reviewed list

path_probe.description: closed TCP ports of hosts the scans reach: the built-in scanner measures whether its own path loses a malformed probe

nuclei_validate.description: an AI-written or approved nuclei template: validate (syntax and a benign loopback fixture) or test (against the targets)

template.description: the template text: a new AI-written one (at most 20,000 bytes) or an installed, approved one (at most 200,000)
